lines: Ba Chou howled, with a look of anguish.
Asuka's charge had been too quick for the eye to catch.
She rushed in with a Mach Punch, which made use of the power output of her Android Arms,
And cut Ba Chou's body apart with a spiral kick and “Wind God: Battle Blade”, a strategy she specialized in which combined both science and Ninja Arts.
A side blow from a metallic tentacle sank into Asuka's abdomen.
She had just barely managed to leap backwards and avoid a fatal wound, but even so, the damage was great.
「I, I'm okay......!! But, what the hell is this monster......?!!」
Asuka bit her lip in irritation.
Its basic power was a threat, but even more of a nuisance was its regeneration ability.
With her leaping into its bosom with a do-or-die mentality, it should have sustained many serious wounds, but――
They regenerated in the blink of an eye, and it looked as though there wasn't even any damage anymore.
「......I explained this, didn't I? That thing is a monster created from the cells of Asagi and Black――It's not going to be easy.」
「Haah...... What an absolutely pain-in-the ass old lady. I mean, at least look after your own cells!」
「Fufu. If you meet again, tell her that in person――Here it comes!」
Space distorted between the howling Ba Chou's arms, and an invisible wave was released.
It was a gravitational vortex harbouring tremendous destructive power.
「H-Hey?! What am I supposed to do about this?!!」
That gravitational vortex passed over the head of Asuka, who had promptly hit the deck.
Caught up in that crucible of destruction, the equipment within the room broke apart with a thunderous noise.
「You can't put your full firepower to work in here. I know a good place.」
This storage room was cramped as it was.
On top of which, it was now littered with the wreckage of the equipment and auction items that Ba Chou had destroyed, as well as the corpses of the guards, and there was nowhere to plant one's feet.
Like this, they would just be at a disadvantage no matter how much effort they exerted.
「――Ayame! Can we get out through your side?!」
Ayame answered, as a guard was shot through the forehead and collapsed.
She was currently confronting the reinforcement guards on the corridor side.
There were only a few remaining.
With this number, they could probably break through with ease.

「Good! Let's move at once.
――Asuka, hold her back, please!」
As they ran, heading for the corridor, Asuka fired away with the machine guns fitted into her Android Arms.
Flesh was gouged out, and burst apart with fresh blood.
Ba Chou gave off an enraged howl, and chased after the trio who were dashing down the passageway.
「Here, eh?! An easy place to fight!!」
「Indeed. We'll take care of it right here!」
At the point where they emerged from the corridor was the hotel's show arena.
It had plenty of space, and it was not currently a time period where a show would be taking place.
If they did it here, they would be able to freely show off Asuka's firepower, which was top-class even among the Taimanin.
In one corner of this arena, which the three of them had barged into, were the figures of a man and woman wearing hotel uniforms.
Had they been having a secret tryst or something? Or had they simply taken care of their remaining work?
Either way, the man and woman, who were petrified with fear, were sitting ducks for Ba Chou, which had burst into the arena.
They could not stand by and watch the hotel staff, who were ordinary civilians, die.
Ba Chou fired its tentacles at them――Or rather, before it could, Asuka threw herself in the way.
The cost for that was high.
Her Android Blades, followed by both of her steel legs as well――
Its metallic tentacles shot towards Asuka, who had had both legs destroyed, and tumbled to the ground.
The bullets that Ayame fired blew apart the back of Ba Chou's head, and at the same time, the masked woman gathered Asuka into her arms and withdrew to the rear.
Naturally, there was no damage to Ba Chou.
The flesh that had been blown off the back of its head regenerated at a fantastic speed.
On the contrary, it instantly deployed its tentacles backwards, and struck Ayame's stomach.
Had she not promptly twisted her body, she would probably have had her innards gouged out entirely.
（What do we do?! It's too risky to keep fighting like this!）
It was impossible to bring down Ba Chou, which had that regeneration ability, with her weapon.
In which case, should she distance herself from it for the time being?――Just when she was thinking that, she caught the eye of the masked woman, who had jumped backwards with Asuka in her arms.
Having done missions with her on several occasions, she understood the masked woman's way of doing things.
With Ba Chou charging at her in front of her eyes, Ayame calmly focused her mind.
In Ayame's field of vision, Ba Chou's onrushing tentacles became heavily blurred, like a double exposure.
Banking on that “image of the future”, she slipped past the tentacles by a paper-thin margin――
Then fired a series of blades and bullets into its body.
“Time Reading” was a Ninja Art which repurposed the “Wind Reading” that Ayame specialized in for interpersonal combat.
Measuring the flow of air that surrounded her, to perfectly predict the future a few moments ahead――
（Well, it's not much use now, though――）
She could not use the mentally demanding “Time Reading” for long.
Ayame's attacks wouldn't work on Ba Chou in the first place, as it had that regeneration ability.
At this rate, it would ultimately result in her just being tortured to death.
The knife of the masked woman, who had suppressed her presence to get close to it, had pierced deep into the centre of its chest.
At the same time――the bellowing Ba Chou's tentacles impaled the masked woman's body.
Her body, which had supposedly been run through, suddenly burst apart as a bundle of papers, and the next moment, she landed unharmed, and smiled.
It was a body swap, via her “Cicada Shell Arts”.
「Isn't that curious? The wound where you were just stabbed won't regenerate. As for why――」
Having interrogated the Ryuumon scientist, the masked woman knew.
Inside Ba Chou's body, there was a core which controlled its regeneration ability.
It was precisely that regeneration core that she had plunged her knife into.
Asuka was holding up her Android Arms, aiming at the crazed monster.
An enormous amount of Taima particles converged and swirled between both of those arms.
It had all been laying the groundwork for this.
Ayame served as a decoy, the masked woman took advantage of that moment of weakness to destroy the regeneration core,
And then, Asuka, who had fallen back, drove in her ultimate skill, the one with the most firepower――
A torrent of light was emitted――
And the massive energy engulfed Ba Chou, burning all of it away to nothing.
There appeared to have been too much power.
Having annihilated Ba Chou, the Taima Super-Particle Cannon had kept going and shot right through the building's outer wall.
The arena's ceiling caved in, and chunks of rubble came down one after another.
「Hey??!! W-Wait?! I can't move right now――」
A huge piece of debris landed a direct strike on Asuka's head.
Her vision went dark, and her consciousness faded.
All sight of Asuka was lost as countless pieces of rubble blanketed the area...
「――Yes, I'm grateful for your assistance. It's thanks to you that we were able to destroy Ba Chou.」
The masked woman smiled, holding a communications device.
This was the secret lab that the DSO owned, where they carried out the maintenance and development of android weaponry.
The masked woman, who had managed to escape from the collapsing show arena and get back to Japan, was currently in this lab, dealing with the aftermath of the mission.
「Oh, yes. We did pay a heavy price, but all I can do is accept it――」
「Yes. Well, give my regards to your master, too. I'll be in touch.」
The masked woman turned off her communications device, then looked at the centre of the lab while making a deep sigh.
「Oh, yes...... We certainly may have destroyed Ba Chou, but the price was great.」
There lay Koukawa Asuka, who had lost all of her Android Arms and Legs.
After gazing at her for a good while, the masked woman suddenly smiled.
「――Wake up, Asuka. I bought you the cakes you asked for.」
「Really?!! From that new place in Shin Minato-ku?!!」
「Of course. With the three-hour queue. I waited an age, thanks to you.」
「Eeehhh～? But you said I could have anything I liked, as my reward for working hard～」
That, in other words, was the “price”.
Asuka couldn't move from the lab until new Android Arms and Legs arrived.
Because of that, the masked woman was running errands out of pocket for the “meritorious” girl.
「Haaah... Anyway, I've got time off, right? Hey, Madam, call Fuuma. I'm gonna mess with him.」
「What are you saying? There's no way you can bring a person from Gosha into our lab, is there?」
「Hmmm～, is that so......? I mean, I heard Madam talking with Ayame-san, though.」
「What? You mean back on the island?」
「Yeah. In that warehouse......... Was Fuuma an acquaintance of Kurenai too?」
Prior to infiltrating the hotel's basement, they had been talking about Ayame's master and Fuuma Kotarou.
Asuka, who had been hiding with her optical camouflage, must have been listening to that too.
「You're still thinking about that? She might be your love rival, eh?」
「Hey――?! Wh-What does that mean......? That's not it at all......」
「――More importantly!! Cake and tea, already! I've been waiting, you know?!」
Asuka suddenly became flustered, and looked away.
With a smile, the masked woman took out a couple of cakes from the box.
